se refer to FIGS. 1 to 9 for a preferable embodiment of the present invention. A two-stage universal joint of the present invention includes a sleeve 1, a driving member 2 and a restricting member 3.

The sleeve 1 defines an axis 11 and includes a receiving groove 12 and an assembling portion 13, and the assembling portion 13 is configured to be assembled to a rotatable tool. The plurality of first projections 14 are disposed on an end of the receiving groove 12 away from the assembling portion 13. An annular recession 18 is disposed between the plurality of first projections 14 and the plurality of second projections 15.
